strings.en: I care not for the means!
The time has come for us, the Hyakki clan, to conquer the world!
The whole world shall be mine!
I'll dispose of you in one stroke!
Defeat them at any cost and seize the Getter Ray amplifier!
Out of my way!
Silence!
Feel the power of the Hyakki clan!!
Curse you, I won't forget this grudge even in death!
I, Burai, King of the Hyakki... Guoooooh!
You won't get away with this either!
Don't give up!
Wh-What an outrage!
Underestimating the Hyakki clan... You'll regret it.
Nngh, a tougher foe than I thought.
What are you dawdling for!
What a blunder!
Hm, what's this!
Hahaha, no attack can shake me!
Waahahaha! Victory is as good as mine!
This is far too easy.
Heh heh heh... Not bad, for an enemy.
Hahaha, no attack can shake me!
I won't let the likes of you lay a finger on me.
Well done!
Do you still not understand!
Blast, don't slack off!
Do you still not get it!
Blast, what an idiot!
What's going on!?
What!?
Fool! This is our golden opportunity!
I'll dispose of you in one stroke!
You underestimate the might of the Hyakki clan!
Blast, what are you doing!
What are you aiming at!? Weren't you aiming at me?
